title: Engineering Data Foundation
description: Connect and normalize engineering delivery, quality, release, and incident data with durable identity, freshness, and provenance.
setup_prompt: Use Engineering Data Foundation for my engineering systems. Preserve my source-of-truth and access policies, connect only authorized sources, normalize and link records with provenance, validate completeness and freshness, and create a durable data-quality report.

setup_inputs.label: Organizations, teams, repositories, projects, and environments
Authorized issue, SCM, CI, deployment, QA, and incident sources
History window, refresh frequency, and timezone
Retention, restricted fields, and metric ownership
Customer workflow states and metric definitions

recommended_tools.name: GitHub or GitLab MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized repositories, commits, pull requests, reviews, and checks

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized work items, projects, states, and relationships

recommended_tools.name: CI and deployment MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized pipeline, build, deployment, and rollback events

recommended_tools.name: Observability and incident MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized incidents, alerts, service identity, and recovery events
